FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Precision Tax and Accounting Services, we specialize in providing comprehensive tax preparation and accounting services to individual taxpayers and small businesses with straightforward financial needs. Our core operations include the preparation of personal and business tax returns, bookkeeping, and maintaining accurate financial records for our clients. We pride ourselves on our commitment to compliance, utilizing industry-standard accounting software and robust data security measures to protect sensitive client information. Our professional team holds current CPA and enrolled agent certifications, ensuring that we adhere to all regulatory standards. We also conduct regular internal audits to maintain high-quality service and compliance with best practices, establishing clear written agreements with our clients to outline service scope and fees. Supporting our clients year-round with clear communication and transparency is at the heart of our operations.
